lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits. The pattern exhibits a gradient in spatial density, where blobs are more closely packed in the dorsal-most rows and become larger and more widely spaced in the ventral-most visible rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal blob rows to form a regular grid pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the mid-flank, characterized by a high-contrast vertical gradient with high luminance on the upper boundary and shadow on the lower boundary, extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 10-12 high-luminance blobs are distributed within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, with a higher concentration of clusters along the anterior margin.
